pairs.difference: A: category 3, the ball sits on rippled sand with a simple band of orange dunes behind it. B: pale sand fills the whole frame with no backdrop, and it carries round crater-like dents and scattered tiny pebbles. Its detail is 0.0081, below the real range; A's 0.0209 is inside it. Both are under the real edge range, so this is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Keep the sand smooth with a few long, soft ripples. Remove the round dents and tiny pebbles. Add a simple warm dune band behind the ball, in the top third of the card.

pairs.difference: A: target and teddy on a plain ledge, with one purposeful secondary prop, four bulbs and a dark green wall. B adds stacked gold cans, a striped ball and a striped flag cone. It also has a scalloped lit sign, bracketed shelf and a brick wall, so the background is full of small objects. Measured detail is close, but the invented props in B are clear.
pairs.fix: Remove the cans, ball and flag. Keep only the target and teddy on a plain wooden ledge. Replace the brick wall with a smooth, plain green wall and use a straight wooden frame.

pairs.difference: A dresses a full room around the unit: window with foliage, curtain, potted plant, stacked books, sofa with cushion, cornice and sun patches on bold stripes. Edge density is 0.073 and detail 0.0238. B is one quiet striped wall with a corner and ceiling, at edge density 0.005 and detail 0.0104.
pairs.fix: Remove the window, curtain, plant, books and sofa. Show only the air conditioner on a quiet tone-on-tone striped wall with soft, plain light.

pairs.difference: A scatters more around the chest: large pink shell, three loose coins, several pebbles and bubbles on rippled sand. B has a smaller shell and two coins on a plainer sand mound, though its bubbles overlap the chest edge and the sand ends oddly at the left. Both measure in range, so the difference is only prop count.
pairs.fix: Keep the sand smooth and clear. Use one shell and one small group of coins at most, with no pebbles and fewer bubbles.

pairs.difference: A's plank wall and floor are saturated orange-red with strong wood grain and invented gold rivets on the posts. Detail is 0.0262 and edge density 0.066, both above the real range. B is a quiet brown corner with broad planks and a soft shadow, at edge density 0.035, inside the range, and detail 0.0213, at the top of it.
pairs.fix: Use plain, quiet brown planks with faint grain. Remove the brass rivets and posts. Keep the floor to a few broad boards with low contrast.

pairs.difference: A's backdrop is small tone-on-tone crowns in an even grid, with some glow around the booth. B's backdrop is large tilted outlined suitcases cropped by the card edges and booth, which is heavier pattern and an unrelated motif. Its detail is 0.0187, above the real 0.008 to 0.013; A's 0.0105 is inside.
pairs.fix: Replace the large tilted suitcases with small, upright tone-on-tone motifs in an even grid, faint against the green wall.

pairs.difference: A has plain wide blue stripes and a clean orange plank floor, like the real striped backdrops. B's stripes carry thin bright and dark lines and a mottled gradient, and its foreground plank has soft grain and knots. Both measure in range, B higher on detail (0.0152 vs 0.0113) and edges (0.040 vs 0.022).
pairs.fix: Use plain wide two-tone blue stripes with no thin lines. Make the floor clean planks with very little grain and no knots.

pairs.difference: A has a strong magenta-white glow pooled behind the fins, inside darkening rings, and detail of 0.0072 falls below the real range. B has evenly spaced quiet purple rings with no halo and detail of 0.0115. The glow resembles the halo on the lesson's generated glove. There are no props on either card.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright glow behind the fins. Keep even, quiet purple rings with low contrast.

pairs.difference: A is a tight crop of the dock over water and a strip of sand, with only a few large quiet shapes. B builds a postcard scene around it: palm, hibiscus, rocks, distant island, clouds, foam line, starfish, shell, pebbles and caustic water. Its detail is 0.0228, above the real range, against A's 0.0127. This matches the lighthouse lesson's invented island and props.
pairs.fix: Crop close on the dock. Show only calm water and a plain strip of sand. Remove the palm, flowers, island, clouds, starfish, shells and pebbles.

pairs.difference: Both are the same staging: palm on a sand mound, a few pale rocks, and a tone-on-tone spiral behind. A has three flat rocks and a few specks. B has four rounder rocks and a stronger cast shadow. Detail is 0.0092 vs 0.0107 and edge density 0.011 vs 0.019, both low in the real range. Nothing here separates them.

A is a clean flat purple wall, thin baseboard and warm plank floor. B's wall is mottled with a soft cast shadow and vignette, with a heavy baseboard, and detail of 0.0218 sits just over the real range against A's 0.0173. Edge density is close and both are inside range.
pairs.fix: Paint the wall one flat, even purple with no mottling. Use a thin baseboard and a simple warm wooden floor.

pairs.difference: A has big soft pink waves, broad pale tiles and a pool curve, at edge density 0.034, inside the real range. B has dense tile grout, a dark tiled pool rim and busy striped waves. Its edge density is 0.065, above the range, with detail of 0.0208. A's splash belongs to the slide and is not added clutter.
pairs.fix: Use broad pale deck tiles with faint joints. Remove the dark tile rim on the pool. Keep the pink wave backdrop soft and low contrast.

pairs.difference: A has flat two-tone violet rings with no light effect. B has a bright magenta glow behind the player, inside saturated darkening rings, and lower detail (0.0094 vs 0.0135). The glow follows the lesson's generated halo. No props on either; both measure in range.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow behind the player. Use flat, even rings in two close tones.

pairs.difference: A has even green rings with soft darkening at the corners. B has a brighter lime glow around the envelope, and softer rings with lower detail (0.009 vs 0.0137) and edge density (0.003 vs 0.010). No props on either; both are in range, so only the halo points to B.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright lime glow around the envelope. Keep even green rings in close tones.

pairs.difference: A fills the frame with diagonal wood planks and strong grain, with no backdrop, and adds loose water drops on the empty plate rim. Its detail is 0.0199 and edge density 0.037. B uses the real category 3 layout, a plain ledge with quiet tone-on-tone stripes behind, at 0.0126 and 0.017.
pairs.fix: Place the plate on a simple wooden surface with faint grain and a quiet striped backdrop above it. Remove the loose water drops from the rim.

pairs.difference: A surrounds the door with many objects: dense vines, lantern, flowerpot, bush, stone steps and paving. Detail is 0.0571 and edge density 0.162, the highest in the set. B has only vines and door frame in a tight crop, at 0.0353 and 0.107. Both exceed the real range, but A is further out and has more invented props.
pairs.fix: Crop closer on the door and wreath. Remove the lantern, flowerpot, bush and paving. Keep a few large, simple leaves at the top corners only.

pattern: Generated cards invent a setting around the hero. They add unasked-for props (islands, starfish, shells, cans, plants, books, lanterns), fill the frame with small repeated detail (grout, grain, leaves, rivets), and put a bright glow behind the object on graphic fields. Real cards use a few large quiet shapes, one purposeful prop at most, and flat tone-on-tone backdrops. Clear calls are the busy scenes (p03, p09). The glow and backdrop calls are weak, so those pairs carry low confidence.
